regions.text: freedom— symbolizing an end as well as a beginning— signifying
regions.explanation: From 4.72s to 8.27s (“freedom— symbolizing an end as well as a beginning— …”), 2 pause(s) at punctuation shrank from 385 ms to 60 ms on average. Pauses at punctuation mark the end of an idea and give the audience time to absorb it; running through them merges separate thoughts into one stream. Fix: Hold a clear pause at each punctuation mark, about as long as the reference.
